newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper extends losses but base metals quiet.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper extends losses but base metals quiet.

text.p: Copper prices extended losses on the metal market on Thursday, with other base metals staying quiet in limited activity, dealers said.

Ready copper slid further by 50 rupees to 11,600 rupees per quintal on continued arrivals of the imported metal. "Indian importers booked a higher quantity of copper in the world market during the recent plunge in prices, fuelling more supplies in local markets," said dealer Sharad Parikh.
Nickel was steady at 37,200 rupees per quintal on stray physical support. Tin was quiet at 35,600 rupees per quintal as was zinc at 6,225 rupees. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
